nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model SGD Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level SGDClassifier, SGDRegressor, SGDOneClassSVM, passive-aggressive, and Perceptron estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above compiled _plain_sgd training boundaries.

nodes.name: sgd_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public SGD-family estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: sgd_public_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the public SGD-family estimator family represented by an estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: sgd_public_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return the learning task represented by a public SGD-family estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: sgd_public_training_boundary
nodes.description: Return the compiled training boundary selected by a public SGD-family estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: sgd_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level SGD-family routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered estimator.

nodes.name: sgd_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public SGD-family fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing compiled training.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object = None, sample_weight: object = None, coef_init: object = None, intercept_init: object = None, offset_init: object = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs, targets, sample weights, and optional init arrays, then packages references without fitting.

nodes.name: sgd_public_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public SGD-family prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction, scoring, or decision execution to sklearn.

nodes.name: sgd_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public SGD-family estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: sgd_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted coefficients, intercepts or offsets, class metadata, iteration counters, and training-boundary metadata after deferred compiled SGD execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes fitted coefficient arrays and scalar metadata already produced by sklearn fitting.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 1 and Case 2 public SGD-family estimator shells over compiled _plain_sgd training boundaries
limitations: The internal update topology is obscured by compiled _plain_sgd and compiled loss/update boundaries.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not stochastic update execution, convergence, dataset construction, validation execution, partial-fit mutation, prediction, decision-function, or scoring internals.
PassiveAggressiveClassifier and PassiveAggressiveRegressor are included only as deprecated public estimator surfaces in sklearn 1.8.
